reviews.title: Strong vibes…
reviews.text: Reading the reviews before I joined really helped, especially seeing how well they responded to the critical reviews. I will say maybe it would be better to start with an easier font to read and then lead into their one, but I also see the character in the font chosen and it is quite defining. Also maybe more clarification on what premium actually does in the menu. Overall, wonderful idea and great execution.

reviews.title: i love this app!!
reviews.text: i am a new user to triday,  but as someone who has been recommended journaling countless of times by my family, personal trainer, teachers and therapist i thought i would give it a try. journaling is something that never really stuck with me but triday made it super easy! i mean for is free also!! so if you have trouble journaling i would recommend this endlessly!

reviews.title: Love it
reviews.text: I’m not one for keeping journals but this one is what I’m encouraged to use. It’s only a few lines at a time and there’s no pressure to try and put in a journal every single day. The days that I’ve missed I don’t stress over, but it’s nice having the little reminder to reflect on the day and to put something in it knowing that in a year from now (or longer) I’ll have something to reflect on. I love the handwritten touch and the pencil and eraser sounds and some fun flare. It’s a unique twist on journaling (kinda makes me want to add my entries to a real journal, a few lines is all it takes).

reviews.title: Excellent app!

reviews.title: Very cute diary!
reviews.text: It’s a very cute, easy to use minimalist diary. It’s nice to only need to write a few lines a day. Sometimes I struggle to find the time (or patience) to sit and write for a while but this takes only a few minutes.

reviews.title: Super simple, great app
reviews.text:
Love the three lines a day. No need to overthink, just quick recap the day and move on.
Awesome, thanks dev!

reviews.title: Minimalistic & fun
reviews.text: Diaries should be easy to write in and recall when you want. This is what it does. Unlike DayOne and others, sometimes you forget why you opened the app in the first place. Looking forward to new-no-exaggerated functions will come! Keep it up!
